essence: The vow binds deity to doctrine in one compound and predicates contraries together — world-shaped yet world-surpassing consciousness, throbbing as supreme power.

sections.SUMMARY: Homage to Śiva-as-the-self-of-all-levels, then the bow to consciousness as the Lord's heart: world-shaped yet world-surpassing, pulsating in supreme-power shape.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is love-address: veneration, bowing, paradox embraced. Opening devotion relished.
